description: Opaque dark olive-green knee-length wool tunic with broad tan-gold Celtic knotwork borders down its front, around cuffs and hem. Cream linen undershirt shows at the wrists and neckline. A dark green cloak crosses the upper chest, fastened at one shoulder by a large round gold knotwork brooch, with wide patterned edging and fringe. A broad brown leather belt has a large round knotwork clasp, smaller round metal plaques and a long decorated hanging strap. Brown loose trousers and tall brown leather boots with crossed lacing complete the outfit. No headgear, armor or weapon is visible.
